    Thank you, I got GTK+ installed by following these instructions --
    it walks through the process of adding GTK+ to the PATH variable at startup.
    http://www.stat.auckland.ac.nz/~kimihia/rgtk2
    but loading the rattle() library causes a window to pop up stating that the
    package XML couldn't be found --
    it asks if I would like to install it, which then shows a 39.5 MB file
    downloaded, that subsequently cannot be installed.
     
    Regardless of whether I use rattle(), or the rattle.install.packages() function,
    or RStudio (both downloading from CRAN & installing the zip file from a
    local directory), or using the R console (both downloading from CRAN &
    installing the zip file from a local directory) produces the message below
    --
     
    Warning in install.packages :
    error 1 in extracting from zip file
    Warning in install.packages :
    cannot open compressed file 'XML/DESCRIPTION', probable reason 'No such
    file or directory'
    Error in install.packages : cannot open the connection
     
     
    Again, any ideas are welcome. thanks, Paul
